30 free datasets to practice AI/ML on (no more Titanic dataset) 📊
Search Engines for Datasets

1. https://t.co/TBiEwXieMW — Google's dataset search engine
2. https://t.co/DAyFwxRjHX — Thousands of shareable ML datasets
3. https://t.co/1ta0oOytc1 — NLP, vision & LLM fine-tuning data
4. https://t.co/X3PrphM9z1 — Datasets tied to research papers
Classic ML Repositories
5. https://t.co/q1KHKcFXm7 — 600+ curated, research-grade datasets
6. https://t.co/2EVv41VQLQ — 200K+ community-uploaded datasets
7. https://t.co/6b52k7XX8a — US government open data
8. https://t.co/T25CRbHKnc — EU government open data
Computer Vision
9. COCO Dataset — Object detection & segmentation
10. ImageNet — 14M+ labeled images
11. CIFAR-10/100 — Classic image classification benchmark
12. Open Images Dataset (Google) — 9M+ annotated images
13. LAION-5B — Massive image-text pairs for generative AI
NLP & LLMs
14. Common Crawl — Petabytes of raw web text
15. The Pile (EleutherAI) — 800GB curated text for LLM training
16. IMDb Reviews — Sentiment analysis benchmark
17. SQuAD — Question-answering benchmark
18. Amazon Reviews Dataset — Millions of product reviews
Finance & Economics
19. Yahoo Finance API — Historical stock data
20. World Bank Open Data — Global economic indicators
21. Lending Club Loan Data — Credit risk modeling
22. Credit Card Fraud Detection (Kaggle) — Fraud classification practice
Healthcare
23. MIMIC-III — De-identified ICU patient data
24. CDC WONDER — US public health statistics
25. COVID-19 Data Repository (JHU) — Historical pandemic tracking data
Geospatial & Climate
26. NASA Earthdata — Satellite & climate datasets
27. OpenStreetMap — Global map & location data
28. NOAA Climate Data — Historical weather records
Recommendation Systems
29. MovieLens — Classic movie ratings dataset
30. H&M Personalized Fashion Dataset — Real e-commerce recommender data
Skip the Titanic dataset.

The future of sustainable fashion will not be defined by a single material, technology or innovation but by our ability to redesign the system itself.

Reflections from the #GlobalFashionSummit2026, shared by @Independent and @GFAgenda, highlight an increasingly important convergence of #Circularity, #AI, responsible production, community and cross-sector collaboration.

For designers and educators, this raises a critical responsibility: we must prepare the next generation not simply to design products, but to understand and challenge the systems in which those products are created, consumed and ultimately discarded.

#Sustainability is no longer an addition to fashion practice, it must become part of how we define design, innovation and value.
